TTArtisan 25mm f/2.0 manual focus lens (read from lens cap in photo 2).

This is a technical specification that cannot be confirmed through external photos.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, the screen working, and a photo being taken.

risks.risk: The rear articulating LCD screen may be cracked or heavily scratched.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the camera with the screen unfolded and visible.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched or excessively dirty.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed.

risks.risk: The mechanical shutter may have a very high actuation count.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from the most recent image's EXIF data.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the rear LCD screen.
Photo of the sensor without the lens attached.
Screenshot of the current shutter count.
response.reason: The camera and lens are clearly identified. It is priced at the worst-case (non-functional) value because there is no proof of operation or condition of the sensor and screen. Note the lens is a third-party manual model, not a Nikon autofocus lens.
